name: B10-0168/2026 (Renew) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the detention of Elene Khoshtaria, a pro-European party leader held on charges the Parliament calls politically motivated, and of others jailed for pro-European activity. It asks Georgia to release them, stop using pre-trial detention against opponents, and allow independent judges. It also asks the European Union to treat this repression as a test in its relations with Georgia and to consider measures against officials responsible.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only states positions and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, detained opponents and activists, and European Union institutions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union bodies and Georgian authorities; no action is binding.
